children: Delta, British Columbia--(Newsfile Corp. - November 26, 2026) - Fab-Form Industries Ltd.
("Fab-Form®", or the "Company") is pleased to announce that the United States Patent and Trademark Office ("USPTO") has allowed the patent claims for its innovative
SPACE-R

product. This allowance represents a significant milestone in the Company's ongoing commitment to innovation, product development and delivering advanced solutions to contractors worldwide. The patent is expected to be formally issued in due course.
SPACE-R

addresses three challenges in creating reinforced concrete columns. First, it replaces the traditional horizontal steel stirrup with a lightweight fiberglass component, significantly reducing shipping costs and eliminating corrosion issues. Second, it utilizes polypropylene clips to connect vertical rebar to the horizontal stirrup, reducing onsite labor and eliminating human error. Thirdly, it features polypropylene fins on the outside to ensure the reinforcement is correctly positioned within the column form, a task typically accomplished with rebar wheels in the industry.
ABSTRACT OF THE DISCLOSURE

There is provided a formwork assembly. The formwork assembly includes a plurality of longitudinally-extending and laterally spaced-apart steel reinforcing bars. The formwork assembly includes a hoop reinforcement shaped to extend about the reinforcing bars. The hoop reinforcement is configured to provide shear strength to concrete poured into the formwork so positioned. The formwork assembly includes a plurality of receptacles circumferentially spaced-apart about, coupled to and radially inwardly-extending from the hoop reinforcement so as to promote a desired positioning or spacing of the reinforcing bars. The formwork assembly includes a plurality of spacers circumferentially spaced-apart about, coupled to and radially outwardly-extending from the hoop reinforcement. The formwork assembly includes a formwork shaped to extend about and be positioned in place via the plurality of spacers. There is further provided a concrete stirrup apparatus comprising said hoop reinforcement, receptacles and spacers.

"SPACE-R is a better way to reinforce a concrete column, and the USPTO's allowance of our claims confirms the strength of the invention," said Rick Fearn, Chief Technology Officer of Fab-Form. "We invented it to save contractors time, shipping costs, and corrosion problems, and we're ready to take it to market."

"Concrete columns go up in every city in the world, and every one of them needs reinforcement," said Joey Fearn, Chief Executive Officer of Fab-Form. "SPACE-R fits the formwork contractors already use, and it works with our own Fast-Tube® fabric form, so we see a large opportunity."

About Fab-Form

Fab-Form Industries Ltd ("Fab-Form®") is a leading eco-friendly concrete forming products manufacturer located in Vancouver, BC Canada. Since its inception in 1986, the Company has invented, developed, and commercialized foundation products that are greener and more sustainable for the building industry.
The Company has traded on the TSX Venture Exchange ("TSXV" under the symbol FBF) since 2000.
